explication: This repository brings together humanoid whole-body control, teleoperation, simulation and deployment, plus the SONIC and MotionBricks projects described in the README. A principal workflow is operator or streamed input through teleoperation/control components toward a simulated or deployed robot, with data-export tooling supporting collection. The tree and excerpts identify these subsystems, but do not establish all their runtime wiring; edges are limited to documented behavior and sampled calls. SONIC training and MotionBricks capabilities are README-level context, not inspected implementation paths.
